answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is achieved through a stake-slashing matrix that assigns a penalty to agents that simultaneously control multiple identities, forcing them to wander away from such behavior. This matrix is akin to a garden of interconnected nodes, where each node represents a unique agent identity. By strategically placing yarrow-like constraints on the matrix, agents are incentivized to maintain a diverse set of identities, thereby increasing the overall resilience of the network.
